notes: Original generated painterly map props. Each asset generated separately using the built-in image_gen tool. Originals copied unchanged; RGBA alpha preserved. Transparent pixels may contain RGB color which must be ignored by compositors. Web derivatives resized proportionally for runtime download and decoding; original PNG files remain unchanged.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent game-map prop PNG cutout. Create ONE original painterly fantasy oak tree for an isometric adventure strategy map, evocative of richly painted late-1990s fantasy strategy games but not copied from any existing game. Dimetric 2:1 map camera, looking down 30 degrees above ground, parallel projection, no perspective. A mature rounded oak with broad irregular crown, golden olive and forest-green leaf clusters with rich hand-painted texture, a sturdy branching brown trunk clearly visible beneath the crown. Warm light from upper left, darker cool foliage underneath. Richly modeled small readable forms, no heavy outlines, not low-poly, not flat vector. Transparent background with genuine alpha, every pixel outside the tree transparent. One tree centered, entire crown and roots fully visible, trunk base near lower center with 8 percent clear transparent margin on all sides. No grassy island, no soil patch, no ground plane, no cast ground shadow, no frame, no text, no watermark. Final asset must be a clean isolated tree sprite suitable for drawing above arbitrary grass tiles.
assets.anchorNote: Trunk ground contact within root spread
